Africa's Richest Person Hires Indian Firm for Refinery Project

Aliko Dangote, identified as Africa's richest person, has hired Engineers India for a project valued at ₹4,302 crore (approximately $450 million). This project involves building a new refinery in Kenya, which is expected to process 700,000 barrels of oil daily and aims to improve regional energy security. Separately, Dangote is planning a fuel pipeline network across Southern Africa costing over $3.5 billion and spanning 2,650 km.
